text:
Dill dip salmon
Dill dip:
1 cups of mayo 
2 tbsp fresh dill or 4 frozen dill cubes
2 tbsp lemon juice 
4 cloves of minced garlic 
1 tbsp of honey 
Himalayan salt 
Pepper

For salmon sprinkle salt, pepper, garlic powder on fish, then schmear the dill dip on it. bake it on 400 (reg oven, 375 on convection oven), until internal temp of 125 on the thickest part
